title: Kissed Turkish Mushrooms Cake
description: A spicy, flaky Turkish mushroom cake that brings the warmth of a cozy kitchen while staying diabetic-friendly. The revani-inspired batter incorporates wild mushrooms and a blend of cumin, paprika, and cayenne for a subtle heat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 9-inch round cake pan.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté sliced mushrooms until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add cumin, paprika, cayenne, and salt to the mushrooms, cooking for an additional 1 minute until fragrant.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a bowl and let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, erythritol, lemon zest, and baking powder until well combined.
Stir in whole wheat flour and almond flour into the wet mixture, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Fold the sautéed mushrooms into the batter until evenly distributed.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan, smoothing the surface with a spatula.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
